description: x402-poly-history: Price time series for a Polymarket outcome token, with the trend statistics agents need (first/last price, change in cents and percent, high, low, average, direction, volatility). Existing Polymarket services here give you a snapshot of the book; this is the only one that gives you where the odds have been, which is what a momentum or mean-reversion decision actually needs.
